data.name: AccountQuotaNotEnforceableNote
data.value: Not currently enforced — this is the plan's allowance, but this server cannot back it with a real disk limit right now, so this account may use more. Mount the filesystem with quota accounting and run quotaon to restore enforcement; the panel will not do this for you.

data.name: AccountQuotaUnmeasuredNote
data.value: Enforcement could not be checked — the server did not report whether it can back this allowance with a real disk limit, so the panel cannot say whether this account is held to it. Try again shortly; if it persists, check that the agent is running.

data.name: LogLevelFatal
data.value: Fatal — only failures that stop the panel

data.name: ClockSyncSynchronized
data.value: The clock is synchronised with a time source.

data.name: ClockSyncNotSynchronized
data.value: A time synchronisation service is enabled but has not synchronised the clock. Two-factor codes, sign-in sessions and certificates may fail until it does; check that the server can reach a time server.

data.name: ClockSyncSyncServiceDisabled
data.value: No time synchronisation service is enabled, so nothing corrects the clock if it drifts. Enable systemd-timesyncd or chrony on this server.
